scripts.bundle:lambda: sed -i '' '\/\/\/ ESBUILD_DEPLOY_STOP/a\'$'\n''/*' index.ts && esbuild index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.js --external:@aws-sdk/* --define:process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' && sed -i '' 's/\/\*//g' index.ts
scripts.deploy: cd ../client && bun run build && cd ../server && bun run bundle:lambda && cd ../infra && bun cdk deploy PaddockStack
scripts.deploy:staging: cd ../client && bun run build:staging && cd ../server && bun run bundle:lambda && cd ../infra && bun cdk deploy PaddockStack-Staging
scripts.deploy:hotswap: bun run bundle:lambda && cd ../infra && bun cdk deploy PaddockStack --hotswap
scripts.deploy:staging:hotswap: bun run bundle:lambda && cd ../infra && bun cdk deploy PaddockStack-Staging --hotswap
scripts.db:seed: AWS_REGION=eu-west-2 NODE_ENV=production bun run db.ts seed
scripts.db:seed:staging: TABLE_NAME_TEST=WiveyCares2-Staging AWS_REGION=eu-west-2 NODE_ENV=production bun run db.ts seed
